behaviour.title: Re-running will duplicate rows, despite the node name
behaviour.detail: "Upsert into Notion" is named as an update or upsert but runs operation create, which always writes a new record. A redelivered webhook, a manual retry or an overlapping scheduled run therefore creates a second copy. Add a unique key on the destination, or switch the operation, before you rely on it.

behaviour.title: The routed arms are not equivalent - the 'auto-approve' arm takes no action of its own
behaviour.detail: Route by Work Type splits the run. The 'needs-review' arm ends at Fast-Track 'needs-review' + Alert, which posts a Slack message to #projects. The 'auto-approve' arm goes to Delegate 'auto-approve' to Sub-workflow, which calls the included sub-workflow lib: Process Auto-Approve Task - that sub-workflow normalises the item and tags it with the route, but performs no action of its own, so the branch completes and nothing is sent, filed or updated for it. Add the handling you want inside lib: Process Auto-Approve Task before relying on that arm.
